about.title: ABOUT US
about.subtitle: International Breeds Registry (INBR) is the leading continental and global body devoted to rigorous registry, pedigree certification, and ethical breeding advancement of canine breeds.
about.missionDesc: To guarantee genealogical authenticity through modern verification processes, safeguarding animal welfare and defining breed standards that elevate functional morphology and the health of Bull breeds.
about.visionDesc: To be the world-renowned canine registry standard for technological innovation, documentary transparency, and premier conformation shows, connecting breeders across all 5 continents.
about.obj1: 100% digital, immutable validation of pedigrees and ISO microchips with worldwide homologation.
about.obj2: Absolute transparency in litter registrations through unforgeable real-time live video recording.
about.obj3: Continuous education of judges, breeders, and handlers under biomechanical and temperament frameworks.
about.obj4: Global expansion of conformation and structure dog shows with auditable online scoreboards.

threeCards.card1Desc: Pedigree certificates with full legal backing, instantaneous QR code verification, and recognition across 28+ countries for elite breeding and show competition.
threeCards.card2Desc: Traceability spanning up to 5 generations with full photographic genograms, cross-association homologation (ABKC, UKC, FCI), and DNA testing integration.
threeCards.card3Desc: Audit of ISO 11784/11785 microchips, centralized database on Supabase Cloud, and total shielding against duplicated or fraudulent records.
